content.text: Sound is something we experience every moment—from speech and music to traffic noise and birdsong. Sound waves are mechanical vibrations that travel through matter, allowing us to communicate, enjoy music, and perceive our environment. Understanding sound waves helps us design concert halls, develop hearing aids, and create better audio technology.
is a longitudinal wave caused by vibrating objects. It travels through a medium (solid, liquid, or gas) as a series of compressions and rarefactions.
